people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt. Therefore I command you to do this thing.
translations.bsb: Remember that you were slaves in the land of Egypt. Therefore I am commanding you to do this.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt: therefore I command thee to do this thing.
